title: Return Tax Share in Pennsylvania, New Jersey and Minnesota
content:
Pennsylvania, New Jersey and Minnesota exempt clothing and footwear from sales tax. For a Returns & Exchanges return on an order shipped to one of those states, a returned line's share of the order's sales tax depends on the line's merchandise class; for any other ship-to state the share is taken over all of the order's merchandise.

## Tax share of a returned line

| Ship-to state on the order | Merchandise class of the line | Line's share of the order's sales tax |
|---|---|---|
| Pennsylvania, New Jersey or Minnesota | Accessories | The line's merchandise credit divided by the order's accessories merchandise that shipped |
| Pennsylvania, New Jersey or Minnesota | Apparel or footwear | None — the line is credited no sales tax |
| Any other state | Any class | The line's merchandise credit divided by the order's net merchandise at placement |

- **Accessories merchandise that shipped:** the booked amount of the order's accessories lines, less any accessories cancelled before dispatch.
- **Net merchandise at placement:** the order's merchandise subtotal less its discount total.
- The sales tax credited on the line is the order's tax figure times this share, multiplied once and rounded half up to the cent only at the end.
- The ship-to state and each line's merchandise class are read from the Online Orders record of the order.

## Cases (hypothetical figures)

| Order | Line returned | Share |
|---|---|---|
| Shipped to Pennsylvania; accessories booked 60.00, none cancelled | A belt with a merchandise credit of 24.00 | 24.00 divided by 60.00, that is 0.4 |
| Shipped to New Jersey | A coat (apparel) | None; no sales tax credited |
| Shipped to Minnesota | Boots (footwear) | None; no sales tax credited |
| Shipped to Ohio; net merchandise at placement 164.00 | A dress with a merchandise credit of 41.00 | 41.00 divided by 164.00, that is 0.25 |
| Shipped to Minnesota; accessories booked 80.00, a 20.00 accessories line cancelled before dispatch | A bag with a merchandise credit of 60.00 | 60.00 divided by 60.00, that is 1 |
